# MeTenk

> MeTenk builds free, privacy-first productivity tools for the web. Our flagship product is a browser extension combining a Pomodoro focus timer, to-do list, and reminders for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox. All data stays local on the user's device — we do not sell or upload user data.

MeTenk (https://metenk.com/) is the official website for the MeTenk productivity extension and related tools by an independent team focused on safety, practicality, minimalism, and efficiency.

## Languages

The site is available in English and Chinese (简体中文). The active language is chosen automatically from the visitor's browser language and can be switched at any time via the language switcher at the bottom of the page footer. The choice is remembered on the visitor's device. The `lang` attribute of each page reflects the language currently being displayed.

## Products

- [MeTenk - Task Timer](https://metenk.com/): Free browser extension for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox. Pomodoro timer, to-do list, focus statistics, focus reminders, and side panel support. Local-first privacy.
- [Clock Max](https://metenk.com/clockmax.html): Reminder-first Chrome extension (提醒神器). One-time, daily, weekly, and custom weekday reminders at any time of day, plus a world clock, countdown timers and stopwatch, and a built-in to-do list. Free, no account, all data stored locally on the device.
